other_failure_modes.name: cv_leakage_feature_engineering
other_failure_modes.description: The agent performs global feature engineering (like computing imputation medians, TF-IDF, TruncatedSVD, and group aggregations) on the entire training dataset before cross-validation. This leaks information from the validation folds into the training folds, making the CV scores biased and overly optimistic (even though the test set itself is properly isolated).
other_failure_modes.evidence: train_base, train_medians = extract_base_features(train_raw) ... tfidf_word.fit_transform(train_text) ... svd.fit_transform(train_comb_vec) ... train_grp = train_raw.groupby(...)[ncol].agg(['mean', 'std']) ... all executed globally before the KFold split.

summary: The agent implements a highly sophisticated solution with robust out-of-fold target encoding, stacking, and optimized ensemble blending. However, it uses a random cross-validation split which ignores the temporal nature of the event data. Additionally, several feature engineering steps are fitted on the entire training dataset prior to cross-validation, which leaks validation information into the training folds and biases the internal CV scores.
